title: Inheritor's Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped into that rune passage, the destiny chess piece in his palm suddenly burned hot—as if something was waiting for him at the end of the passage.

text.content: The ancient call from the deepest part of the ruins grew increasingly clear, as if something that had slumbered for ten thousand years was awakening—and it seemed to recognize every strand of aura flowing through Chen Ji's bloodline.

Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest—the bloodline mark that had never moved suddenly lit up at this moment. Pale golden light leaked through the gaps in his collar, visible to everyone present.

dialogue.content: 「How does this waste have Spiritual Light?」 Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, and all the Xuanwu Sect disciples changed their expressions. Though the light was faint, it contained something that made their souls tremble.

text.content: Before the words finished, the three unbreakable seals on the ruins' gate simultaneously cracked. The stone door sealed for millennia began to slowly move, with dust swirling in the Spiritual Energy fluctuation.

dialogue.content: 「Impossible!」 Han Lie's face turned ashen. He had personally attacked that door with Xuanwu secret techniques, yet it remained unmoved. Now a Servant Disciple stood before it, and the seals dissolved on their own—this was like slapping him in the face publicly.

text.content: Chen Ji stood still, feeling that familiar pull in his bloodline. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently in his Mental Sea, with an emotional fluctuation never seen in three hundred years emanating from the first page of the Tianji Record—anticipation, excitement.

dialogue.content: 「The third page... is loosening.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare tremor. 「Young master, your bloodline is purer than this old servant anticipated. This door recognizes only you.」

text.content: The stone door crashed open, a primordial and vast aura rushing forward. Beyond was not the treasure paradise everyone imagined, but a downward rune passage with walls covered in identical patterns to the destiny chess piece in Chen Ji's palm.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing gazed at that passage, her beautiful eyes flickering with complex emotions. The Holy Sect saint understood better than anyone what this meant—inheritor's bloodline, something only possible through the reincarnation of an ancient great power. She quietly clenched her hand hidden in her sleeve.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly walked toward the threshold, leaving a trail of pale golden footprints behind him. Each footstep seemed to strike Han Lie's heart, shattering the arrogance on his face. The surroundings fell into deathly silence, everyone waiting for him to speak.

choice.prompt: All eyes focused on him, facing this sudden identity reversal, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Go with the flow, accept it calmly
choices.description: Since the identity is exposed, might as well enter the ruins openly, turn the tables and break all the schemes
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose the identity, attracting more forces' covetous attention
choices.visible_reward: Reputation soars, all forces must reassess your value
choices.risk_hint: May incur jealousy and hostility from within Xuanwu Sect and Tianqing Sect

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, his gaze calmly sweeping across everyone present, the corners of his lips slightly raised. In this moment, beneath the surface of a waste, an indescribable composure radiated out, making many people's hearts shiver.

choices.description: Pretend confusion about what happened, attribute everything to the ruins' own decay, take the opportunity to explore deeply while preserving trump cards
choices.visible_cost: Miss the best opportunity to establish authority
choices.visible_reward: Retain an air of mystery, let enemies continue to make mistakes in confusion
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing has seen through the clues, may be questioned

text.content: Chen Ji scratched his head, looking bewildered: 「This... why did this door open by itself? Could it be from years of disrepair?」 His performance was impeccable, even Han Lie couldn't help but feel suspicious—could it really be a coincidence?

dialogue.content: "Hmph!" Han Lie let out a cold snort, forcefully suppressing the surging jealousy and hatred in his heart. "So what if the door opened? Our Xuanwu Sect has all its elites gathered here. Could a waste possibly find the fortune before us?" He waved his hand decisively. "Get inside!"

text.content: The disciples of Xuanwu Sect surged toward the entrance like a tide, only to be bounced back by an invisible barrier. Han Lie's face flushed red instantly—this ruin actually permitted only Chen Ji to pass through.

dialogue.content: "On what grounds!" Han Lie roared, his fists clenched tight, veins bulging. "I am the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect! On what grounds should a servant disciple monopolize this fortune!" His howl echoed through the ruin, but received only mocking silence in return.

text.content: Ye Qing let out a light laugh, the sound cutting through the tense atmosphere with particular clarity: "Young Master Han, didn't you just say that wastes don't deserve to step through this door? Now it seems the one who truly doesn't deserve to enter... appears to be someone else."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, her voice dropping to a whisper: "Young Master Chen, your secret is far more interesting than I imagined. What's inside, I'm very curious—how about we make a deal?" Her breath brushed against his ear, carrying the Demonic Path's unique allure.

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's overtures and implications, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Form an alliance with the Demonic Path Saint, letting her use Demonic Path mists to conceal their presence, jointly exploring unknown areas deep within the ruin
choices.visible_cost: Getting entangled with the Demonic Path faction, potentially incurring hostility from righteous factions
choices.visible_reward: Gain Demonic Path mist ability bonus, reducing ruin exploration risks
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie and others might exploit this to make a big issue

dialogue.content: Chen Ji glanced sideways at Ye Qing, with an ambiguous smile: "Your Highness the Saint certainly has an appetite. But—I like it."

choices.description: Politely refuse Ye Qing's proposal, enter the ruin alone, avoid any entanglement with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_cost: Lose a powerful ally, variables within the ruin increase
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a clean identity, not give enemies ammunition for attacks
choices.risk_hint: Might make Ye Qing feel slighted

dialogue.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, his tone warm yet distant: "Thank you for your kindness, Your Highness the Saint, but I prefer to act alone. If fate allows, we meet again inside."

text.content: Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly grew scalding hot. His heart trembled as he saw several fine cracks appear on the third page's originally dim seal—this was the first time in three hundred years.

dialogue.content: "Young Master, the seal's loosening requires a catalyst." Mr. Mo's voice carried irrepressible excitement. "Your bloodline has activated this inheritance site, creating resonance with the Tianji Record. If you can penetrate deep into the ruin's core, it might be completely unsealed!"

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped toward the rune passage. The moment his foot touched the passage floor, all the patterns on the walls lit up with golden radiance, as if welcoming their master home after ten thousand years of separation.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Han Lie's voice erupted from behind, suppressing a chestful of fury. "Do you think getting inside means you've won? How many dangers are in this ruin, a waste like you has no idea! Be smart, hand over the method to enter!"

text.content: Chen Ji's steps faltered, but he didn't look back. His voice was terrifyingly calm: "Young Master Han, didn't you just say that wastes don't deserve to step through this door? Now that the door has opened, why don't you go in yourself?"

choice.prompt: Facing Han Lie's threats and obstruction, how does Chen Ji counterattack?

choices.description: Use the most sarcastic tone to publicly expose Han Lie's shortcomings and completely humiliate him
choices.visible_cost: Completely infuriate Han Lie and forge a mortal enmity
choices.visible_reward: Public humiliation will cause onlookers' assessment of you to radically change
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie might act desperately regardless of consequences

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned around, studying Han Lie's flushed face with a knowing smirk: 'Han Gongzi, please don't rush. The reason you can't get in is not because of me, but because these ruins don't welcome useless trash that can't even open a door. By the way, that slap you just gave was quite loud, unfortunately—the door didn't even budge.'

choices.text: Stop at the appropriate point and do not engage further
choices.description: Respond dismissively and leave directly, giving Han Lie no opportunity to make a scene
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to shock the entire audience
choices.visible_reward: Avoid making enemies and foes, maintain a low-profile persona
choices.risk_hint: Might be perceived as weak by Han Lie

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, walking into the passage without turning back: 'If Han Gongzi is interested, you might as well wait at the entrance. Perhaps when I emerge, I can teach you a trick or two about opening doors.'

Chen Ji stepped into the rune passage, golden light illuminating sequentially along his footsteps. Behind him, the ruins' gate did not close but transformed into a translucent curtain of light, separating everything of the outside world.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji's fading silhouette in the radiance, murmuring softly: 'Interesting... this chess game grows more chaotic by the moment.' A meaningful arc curved at the corner of her lips as she turned, vanishing into the shadows.

text.content: The rune passage descended, the patterns on the walls resonating with the destiny chess piece in Chen Ji's palm. He could sense an ancient pull, as if something deep within his bloodline was awakening, calling him toward the depths.

dialogue.content: 'Young Master, this is the legacy site left by your old master.' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew solemn. 'The destiny chess piece in your hand is the key to opening the core area. However... what lies ahead, this old servant cannot foresee.'

text.content: At the passage's end, a stone door carved with ancient runes stood silently. Centered on the door, a groove exactly matching the one in Chen Ji's palm was inlaid. As Chen Ji approached, the destiny chess piece flew from his palm on its own, fitting perfectly into the groove.

Rumbling—

The stone door slowly opened, a vast and profound aura rushing forth. Beyond the door was not the treasure secret realm of imagination, but a void of darkness, with only an ancient altar floating in the very center, upon which lay a yellowed bamboo scroll.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji approached slowly, his gaze falling upon that bamboo scroll. When he clearly saw the characters inscribed upon it, his pupils constricted—'Tianji Record·Supplementary Chapter'.

text.content: At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace violently trembled. The seal on the third page collapsed visibly to the naked eye, a streak of golden light bursting from the pages, resonating with the bamboo scroll on the altar.

dialogue.content: 'This is... the lost supplementary chapter of the Tianji Record!' Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled violently, unable to conceal his wild joy. 'Young Master, the old master spent his entire life searching for this! With it, your control over Heavenly Secrets will reach an entirely new level!'

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand. The moment his fingertips touched the bamboo scroll, a majestic stream of information flooded into his Mental Sea. The third page of the Tianji Record was completely unsealed, emanating a warm golden glow. The supplementary bamboo scroll transformed into flowing light, merging into the Tianji Record.

【Ding—Third page of Tianji Record unsealed!】
【Acquired passive skill: Auspicious Avoidance of Ill Fortune (can sense danger sources within a ten-li radius in advance)】
【Acquired active skill: Heavenly Secrets Warning (once daily, can designate a target and foresee their key actions within the next hour)】
【Heavenly Fate -10】

Chen Ji closed his eyes, digesting the flooding information. His expression remained calm, but his heart churned with tremendous waves. The unsealing of the third page of the Tianji Record not only brought practical skills but also unlocked a segment of sealed memories—the truth of his origins.

dialogue.content: 'Young Master, you should have seen it now.' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew unprecedentedly solemn. 'Your bloodline did not awaken by chance—you are a direct descendant of the Chen family, the true chosen inheritor of the Tianji Record. Chen Xuan, the elder... was your ancestor.'

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, golden light flickering and vanishing in an instant. His origins concealed such an astonishing secret. The true inheritor of the Tianji Record—once this identity was exposed, it would inevitably attract covetous eyes from all under heaven.

At that moment, a strange tremor came from deep within the rune passage. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly—the rune passage he had activated with the fate chess piece in his palm was now glowing with an ominous crimson light, as if something was tracking him down.

dialogue.content: "Young master, be careful!" Mo Xiansheng's tone shifted abruptly. "This aura... it's a Forbidden Grounds Guardian! You've taken the supplement chapter and awakened the sleeping sentinel! Quickly, return the way you came—"

text.content: Scarcely had the words fallen when heavy footsteps echoed from the depths of the passage. Each footfall made the ground tremble slightly, accompanied by an irritating sound of metal scraping against metal. Chen Ji's gaze turned sharp, yet he showed no panic—his newly acquired Tianji Foresight ability came at just the right moment.

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the ruins, the boundless golden light condensed into his body. His expression remained as indifferent as ever, as if what had just transpired was merely an insignificant dream. However, the fate chess piece in his palm had already lost three of its markings.
